name: mono-transcribe
description: Локальная SPA/PWA для записи и русской транскрибации

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs core.mjs healthcheck.mjs public/*.js public/ui/*.js backend/*/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.launcher:test: cd launcher && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
